name: Fairmont Grand Del Mar
insider_take: This Mediterranean-inspired resort sits on 400 acres of rolling hills just 5 miles from the Pacific, where Tom Fazio's championship golf course has hosted PGA Tour events and luxury meets laid-back California cool.
whats_special: The resort's signature Tom Fazio golf course is ranked among California's top resort courses and features dramatic elevation changes with views of the Los Peñasquitos Canyon Preserve. The property's restaurant, Amaya, showcases ingredients from the resort's own organic farm and beehives.
pro_tip: Book a sunset horseback ride through the adjacent Los Peñasquitos Canyon Preserve – you'll spot rare California wildlife and enjoy panoramic views that most San Diego visitors never see.
dont_miss: The resort's falconry experience with master falconers, where you can fly hawks and owls against the backdrop of the canyon preserve. It's one of only a handful of luxury resort falconry programs on the West Coast.
pros: Championship Tom Fazio-designed golf course on-site
Award-winning spa with comprehensive wellness facilities
Multiple dining venues including fine dining restaurants
cons: Resort location away from downtown San Diego
